headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by strong AI‑driven sales.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, the highest in the cohort. HCLTech and LTM posted double‑digit YoY revenue growth, buoyed by AI contracts. Wipro grew revenue modestly but saw a dip in net profit. Several peers (Infosys, OFSS, Coforge, Mphasis) have not released results yet.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: HCLTech highlighted a 78% YoY jump in AI revenue and advanced AI deals; TCS and Wipro noted AI contributions crossing 10% of total revenue.

themes.title: Dividend payouts
themes.detail: Four companies announced interim dividends ranging from ₹12 to ₹25 per share, reflecting cash generation strength.

themes.title: Revenue momentum
themes.detail: All reporting firms posted YoY revenue growth above 9%, with the highest at 15.6% for Tech Mahindra.
